summary: Iter C — Operations Center backend + frontend testing. Backend 8/8 pytest tests PASS. Regression on iter153E (9), iter155 (12), iter153B (10) all PASS. Frontend rendering verified across AdminHub (full mode, 14 cards) + HrHub/PmHub/ShopHub/DispatchHub (compact mode, up to 4 cards). Found and FIXED two missing hookups: HrHub.jsx was referencing <OperationsCenter/> without importing it, and DispatchHub.jsx had the import but never rendered the component. After fixes, all 5 hubs render the OperationsCenter correctly. Card navigation (tasks_overdue→/tasks?status=Overdue, po_pending_approval→/po-requests?status=Pending%20Approval) works. audit_coverage card shows non-zero coverage (21% with po_requests at 100%, employees/incidents 0%). Mobile 375x812 AdminHub: zero horizontal overflow, 14 cards stacked to 1-column grid. PM scope correctly returns {tasks_overdue, po_pending_approval, po_overdue_receipt, incidents_open, ca_overdue, doc_exp_expiring} and excludes equipment_down/po_missing_receipt. role_override admin→hr works; non-admin role_override is ignored (no escalation).

fixed_issues.issue: Used <OperationsCenter compact .../> without importing it — runtime ReferenceError, ops-center never rendered on /hr. Added import statement.
Imported OperationsCenter but never rendered it in the JSX tree. Added <OperationsCenter compact className="mb-4" /> above the Tabs.

critical_code_review_comments: OperationsCenter.jsx (208 lines) is clean and well-scoped — single file, reuses tintFor() helper, no DRY issues.
operations_center.py uses asyncio.gather for parallel probe fan-out — fast and respectful of Mongo indexes (all count_documents on indexed fields).

audit_coverage aggregation correctly drives off the canonical 'audit[]' array marker. coverage_pct currently 19-21% which honestly reflects only po_requests migrated to append_audit — good migration signal.
role_override is admin-gated server-side (line 127-128) — non-admin overrides silently ignored, no privilege escalation possible.
All ops cards correctly carry key/label/severity/url + count|value fields per the contract.

rca of the issue: HrHub.jsx and DispatchHub.jsx hookup miss: developer added the JSX reference in HrHub but forgot the import, and added the import in DispatchHub but forgot the JSX. Both are typical copy-paste-from-AdminHub oversights. Symptom: silent failure on HR (React renders nothing for undefined component) and missing surface on Dispatch (no error, just absent). Fix: 1-line import add to HrHub + 1-line JSX insert to DispatchHub above the Tabs block.
